insights.concise_text: Integrating boundary assembling into the LSTM-CRF pipeline yields a 2% absolute improvement on overall F1 score over current state-of-the-art methods on the Sina Weibo training and test datasets.

triple.subject: boundary assembling integrated into the LSTM-CRF pipeline
triple.object: current state-of-the-art methods by 2% absolute overall F1 score on the Sina Weibo training and test datasets

insights.concise_text: Boundary assembling addresses Chinese word segmentation errors that can cause cascading failure in NER by preserving sense groups and improving downstream NER results.

triple.subject: boundary assembling
triple.object: cascading failure in NER from Chinese word segmentation errors

insights.concise_text: The boundary assembling strategy reduces the influence of different segmentation criteria and finds named entities with long word length, addressing two Chinese word segmentation challenges.

triple.subject: boundary assembling strategy
triple.object: Chinese word segmentation by reducing segmentation-criteria influence and finding named entities with long word length

insights.concise_text: The model trains CWS on the SIGHAN 2005 bakeoff PKU corpus and NER on 1,890 Sina Weibo messages, so its 2% absolute F1 improvement supports cross-domain robustness.

triple.subject: 2% absolute F1 improvement
triple.object: CWS from the SIGHAN 2005 bakeoff PKU corpus and NER from 1,890 Sina Weibo messages

insights.concise_text: The NER CRF uses the LSTM hidden vector as dynamic feature input, and that hidden vector contains segmentation information updated by the boundary assembling method.

triple.subject: LSTM hidden vector
triple.object: boundary assembling-updated segmentation information as dynamic feature input to CRF for NER

insights.concise_text: The boundary assembling method depends on pre-trained lexical features to identify adjacent nouns, so out-of-vocabulary datasets may limit model performance.

triple.subject: pre-trained lexical features
triple.object: boundary assembling on out-of-vocabulary dataset

insights.concise_text: The best model performance with dropout rate 0.1 and learning rate 0.05 was trained until the F1 score of NER model converged on the validation dataset, or up to 30 epochs.

triple.subject: best model performance with dropout rate 0.1 and learning rate 0.05
triple.object: training until the F1 score of NER model converges on the validation dataset, or up to 30 epochs

insights.concise_text: The LSTM module uses character-positional embeddings pre-trained over 112,971,734 Weibo messages, while the NER dataset contains 1,890 Sina Weibo messages.

triple.subject: character-positional embeddings pre-trained over 112,971,734 Weibo messages
triple.object: NER dataset of 1,890 Sina Weibo messages

insights.concise_text: The two-stage training uses 13,500 sentences for training step one and 1,350 sentences for training step two, matching the NER corpus training split of 1,350 messages.

triple.subject: training step two with 1,350 sentences
triple.object: NER corpus training split of 1,350 messages

insights.concise_text: The conclusion that the approach is effective is supported by the experiment result showing an absolute improvement of 2% for the overall F1 score.

triple.subject: absolute improvement of 2% for the overall F1 score
triple.object: conclusion that the approach is effective
